svg.title: flowchart diagram
svg.desc: A flowchart diagram with 120 nodes and 130 edges. Flowing top to bottom. Key nodes: Node 0, Node 1, Node 2. Key relationships: Node 0 points to Node 1; Node 1 points to Node 2; Node 2 points to Node 3. Layout spans 198 by 13252 units with 120 rendered node boxes and 130 routed edge paths.
